findings.description: Actionable defects only. Use an empty array when none; unresolved gate findings require changes_requested, never passed. Put verification constraints in limitations.

limitations.description: Verification constraints and unrun checks; never actionable source defects. Required acceptance gaps still require blocked status.

capability_requests.description: Missing local tools/runtime that the system should provision. Only for blocked status; otherwise use []. Never use this for owner/legal/production approval.
